description: A pre-filled River strategy card link (Base, ST0x stocks). Cards and fields: dip (budget, start, step, rungs); peg (amount, discount, max); recurring (budget, days, hours, max); cycle (budget, buy, step, levels, repeat, top, sell); take-profit (amount, target); sell-ladder (amount, first, last, parts); stop (amount, trigger, floor); breakout (amount, trigger, max); spread (amount, spread, weekend); portfolio (amount, preset, stocks). Missing fields are left for the user. See https://theriver.markets/llms.txt for what each card does. The user reviews this on The River and signs in their own wallet; nothing happens until they do.

fields.description: Card fields as plain decimals, e.g. {"amount":"100","discount":"0.3"}

symbol.description: Ticker or token symbol, e.g. NVDA or wtNVDA (not for portfolio)
